text: Hello, boys and girls, it's me, Ms.Feng.小朋友们,你们好,很高兴再次见到你们哦。上课前,请你准备好你们的英语书和练习册哦。上课时,Please listen carefully, 认真听。Watch carefully, 仔细看, and speak loudly, 大声说哦。Are you ready?Here we go!Look, Ms.Feng and the children are watching Jack's show.Let's watch together.如果你可以的话,也可以跟着唱一唱哦。How nice!The children like Jack's show and his funny face.Let's be Jack, listen and follow.我们一起扮演Jack,说一说吧。This is my mouth.This is my nose.This is my eye.This is my ear.You all speak loudly.你们说得真响亮呀。Feng and the children go back to school.Feng和小朋友们回到了学校。Look, they are playing a game.他们正在做游戏呢。How to play the game?Let's watch.我们来看看该怎么玩这个游戏吧。Touch your nose.小朋友们要摸摸自己的鼻子。And say, this is my nose.Peter, you are the first.Peter, 你的反应最快。Big hands for you, Peter!小朋友们,你们知道该怎么玩这个游戏了吗?第一步,touch, 摸一摸。Touch your ear.第二步, say, this is my nose.你们清楚了吗?Let's play the game together.Ready?Touch your mouth.Well done, children.第三轮,第四轮,我和你们一起玩哦。Touch your eye.你做对了吗?Good job!最后一轮。你说对了吗?你们的反应可真快啊!Big hands for you!Look!Miss Fang给小朋友们布置了一项任务,画一画同学的脸。Look at Danny's picture.看一看Danny的画吧。Who is she?Oh, Alice.Hi, Alice.It's you.This is your mouth.My mouth?This is your eye.My eye?This is your ear.No, it's not me.Yes, she is Alice.You watch carefully.小朋友们,你们看得真仔细啊!What does Danny say?Danny说了什么呢?Listen.Danny says.You try.Good.Look at Danny.What does he point at?看Danny指着什么呢?Mouth or Nose?Yes, mouth.Listen to them.Follow me.What does Alice say?Alice又会说什么呢?Listen to Danny.Danny makes a chant.听Danny正在唱儿歌呢。Mouth?Your mouth?Is it nice?Danny's picture is funny.Let's be Danny and Alice.Listen and follow.Danny的话可真有趣啊。我们一起扮演Danny和Alice说一说吧。Hi Alice, it's you.Danny又会说什么呢?This is your eye or this is your ear?Danny says, you try.She says, you try.Danny is saying a chant.Danny正在说儿歌呢。Is it fun?Let's have a try.我们一起试一试吧。小白说,你试试看吧。Danny说,你试试看吧。小朋友们,你们说的和Danny一样好听啦。Let's say in rows.我们来分角色说一说吧。Voice,Danny.Girls, Alice.Look, this is your eye.Voice, please.Girls, please.What does he say?Danny,这次你会说什么呢?Look, this is your ear.Alice, 你会说什么呢?She says, no, it's not me.Now, please take out your English book.打开英语书,翻到第十二页。Say and act.Let's listen, look, and say.Look, this is your mouth.Does Alice like Danny's picture?No, look, she draws a new picture.她给自己画了一幅画,好看吗?Let's be Alice and say.我们一起扮演Alice,说一说吧。This is my face.Look, it's me.小朋友们,虽然我们每个人的五官都是不一样的,但是他们都是我们身体的重要组成部分哦!你们今天的表现可真棒啊!课后,如果你感兴趣的话也可以用英语课,课后,如果你感兴趣的话如果你感兴趣的话,也可以用英语向爸爸妈妈介绍自己的五官哦!See you next time!Bye bye!
